front.title: AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis, and a human did too
front.tldr: An AI system has produced a claimed proof of the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis, with a competing human-derived proof submitted separately. Mathematicians are now checking both claims.

front.title: GTA 6 made $3.79 billion in its first day, but Rockstar's workers still lack job security
front.tldr: Grand Theft Auto 6 earned $3.79 billion on its first day, Rockstar's biggest launch yet, while staff continue voting on union recognition.

front.title: V8 engines return confirmed in bid to 'reconnect with DNA' of F1
front.tldr: Formula 1 has confirmed it will return to V8 engines from the 2030 season, with the FIA calling it a chance to reconnect with the sport's roots.

stories.title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac
stories.tldr: Apple is reportedly developing an AI agent able to carry out tasks on a Mac, positioning it against Meta's Muse, Instinct and OpenAI's Dots.

stories.title: Anthropic's 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO
stories.tldr: Anthropic's seven founders sold shares worth almost $2 billion combined at $83 a share in the company's IPO, which valued Anthropic at close to $105 billion.

stories.title: Daniel Ek backs an AI researcher's fusion power startup
stories.tldr: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is backing Europa Fusion, a fusion power startup founded by an AI researcher, the latest tech money flowing into nuclear fusion.

stories.title: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?
stories.tldr: OpenAI has introduced MedChemBench, a benchmark testing how well AI models interpret molecular structures and reason from evidence to pick promising drug candidates in early-stage discovery.

stories.title: Super-hot rock geothermal could end data center energy woes
stories.tldr: A wave of geothermal startups is betting that super-hot rock drilling can deliver terawatts of power almost anywhere, addressing the energy crunch behind new AI data centres.

stories.title: Teenage Engineering's first CD player kind of looks like a turntable
stories.tldr: Teenage Engineering has launched its first CD player, the $329 EP/BC-1, styled like a turntable and opening a new line of broadcast-style audio gear.

stories.title: IconSwapper brings live AI usage data to your Mac's app icons
stories.tldr: A new Mac app called IconSwapper animates your app icons with real-time data, letting you see things like live AI usage at a glance.

stories.title: Anthropic rival says companies can mostly skip the pricey models
stories.tldr: On the day Anthropic went public, Fireworks AI's co-founder argued most companies don't need the priciest models, making the case for cheaper open-source alternatives instead.

stories.title: Finally, Apple can reveal the UK backdoor demand
stories.tldr: Apple can now confirm what was long suspected: the UK government ordered it to restrict iCloud's Advanced Data Protection for new users there in February 2025.

stories.title: iOS 27 lets you use two iPhones with the same phone number
stories.tldr: iOS 27 can now share one phone number across two iPhones, Apple's latest update confirms.

stories.title: Signal now blocks screenshots on iPhone to stop Siri AI from seeing chats
stories.tldr: Signal has rolled out an iPhone update that disables screenshots by default, blocking Apple's Siri AI from reading users' chats.

stories.title: Jon McCormack retires from Apple
stories.tldr: Apple executive Jon McCormack has retired after years in an essential role at the company, leaving what Daring Fireball calls big shoes to fill.

stories.title: David Fincher defends use of AI amid 'Cliff Booth' criticism
stories.tldr: David Fincher has defended his use of AI on The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth after criticism, arguing the technology exists and should be used.

stories.title: Home Alone sequel in development at Disney with Macaulay Culkin, Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg
stories.tldr: Disney is developing a new Home Alone film with Macaulay Culkin expected to reprise Kevin McCallister, written and produced by Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg.

stories.title: Project Hail Mary breakout James Ortiz on the art of puppetry
stories.tldr: Puppeteer James Ortiz explains how practical puppetry, not CGI, brought Project Hail Mary's alien character Rocky to life, drawing awards-season attention for the craft.

stories.title: 'Disclosure Day' did its biggest stunts practically, so the VFX team worked hard to look invisible
stories.tldr: Disclosure Day VFX supervisor Matthew Butler says the film's biggest stunts were shot practically, with visual effects used mainly to make that stunt work invisible on screen.

stories.title: Neemias Queta is flourishing for the Celtics
stories.tldr: Celtics coach Joe Mazzulla says Neemias Queta's growth has gone under the radar, after Boston's 131-94 win over the Mavericks showcased his anchoring of the defence.

stories.title: Patriots get update on Drake Maye and A.J. Brown's injuries
stories.tldr: Drake Maye's fractured fibula won't need surgery but puts his season availability in doubt, with A.J. Brown also sidelined by a hamstring injury, the Patriots said.

stories.title: Daniel Jones released by the Colts, as Patriots weigh a possible move
stories.tldr: The Colts have released quarterback Daniel Jones, with the Patriots now being discussed as a possible landing spot given their ongoing need at the position.

stories.title: Russell fastest in final Las Vegas practice after Verstappen collision
stories.tldr: George Russell topped the final Las Vegas Grand Prix practice session after colliding with Max Verstappen during a tense battle for track position.

stories.title: Antonelli hit with grid penalty for Las Vegas GP
stories.tldr: Kimi Antonelli has been handed a five-place grid penalty for the Las Vegas Grand Prix after exceeding his season's engine allocation again.

stories.title: Max Verstappen: "I really thought that we would not win a race this year"
stories.tldr: Max Verstappen says that back in March he doubted Red Bull would win a race all season, a low point now contrasted by a run of eight consecutive podiums.

stories.title: Red Sox trade RHP Johan Oviedo to Diamondbacks, receive LHP in return
stories.tldr: The Red Sox have traded right-hander Johan Oviedo to the Diamondbacks, acquiring minor-league left-hander Luke Dotson in return.

stories.title: Red Sox sign 4 players, tender contracts to Duran, Rutschman and more
stories.tldr: The Red Sox tendered contracts to Jarren Duran, Adley Rutschman and others, and signed four new players, ahead of MLB's non-tender deadline.

finally.title: The Nine Inch Nails Live Archive
finally.tldr: A new online archive lets fans download and stream more than 1,900 recordings from over 1,200 Nine Inch Nails concerts.
